title: Slope Run
description: Steer a high-speed sphere down an endless 3D slope track, hit boost pads, jump gaps, and dodge coral hazard blocks.

title: Grid Snake
description: Steer the growing geometric serpent across the board, collect golden orbs, and beat your longest streak.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Deflect the steel sphere off your paddle to shatter layered brick formations before your lives run out.

title: Block Stack
description: Rotate and drop falling tetrominoes to clear horizontal lines with ghost placement preview and hard drop.
controls: Arrows to move/rotate, Space to drop

title: Sky Hopper
description: Thread a paper glider through dusk monolith gaps with single-tap lift physics and crisp medal milestones.

title: Tile 2048
description: Slide numbered tiles across a 4x4 grid, merge matching powers of two, and reach the 2048 tile.

title: Mine Grid
description: Deduce hidden mine coordinates from adjacent cell counts with safe first-click generation and flag mode.
controls: Click to reveal, Right-click to flag

title: Paddle Duel
description: Fast table-tennis rally against an adaptive opponent or a second local player on the same keyboard.

title: Pair Match
description: Flip geometric symbol cards to clear the board in the fewest moves and fastest time.
